outcome: Every candidate execution emits validated, ordered lifecycle and meaningful-work telemetry, malformed telemetry makes the variant ineligible, and a complete Development-Probe run exposes one watcher-readable feed identifying atom, probe, case, approach, state, and last completed work.
practical_value: An operator can distinguish real progress, a wrong execution, a rejection, and a stall without opening stderr or reconstructing nested run directories.
stopping_condition: A successful candidate has code-owned start and terminal events, at least one validated namespaced work or decision event, and an integrity result; missing, malformed, or non-monotonic events make it ineligible; an operator failure records the failing boundary and actionable correction before its terminal event; the complete-run feed preserves positive monotonic sequence and full atom, probe, case, and approach identity.

captured_cases.expected_outcome: The eligible candidate exposes ordered start, meaningful work, finish, and integrity events in both variant and complete-run telemetry.
Missing or non-monotonic operator telemetry is ineligible, and a crashed operator records its failing boundary and correction before terminalization.
